ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white covering approximately 88% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pigmentation localized at the margins and distal tips comprising the remaining 12%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally located contiguous white expanse across both lobes; black pigmentation is restricted to the trailing edge boundaries and distal tips; sparse, low-intensity dark speckling is distributed non-uniformly across the white ventral field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees; deep vertical depth relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the medial trailing edge; amplitude of variations increases significantly toward the distal tips, creating a jagged, irregular boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoid curvature along the trailing edge; convex sweep from the median notch transitioning to a pronounced upward concavity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the black distal tips of both lobes; multiple small dark circular clusters scattered across the white regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged loss of tissue/contour along the outer trailing edge of the right lobe; prominent biological colonization (barnacles) at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Single distinct dark circular focal point located near the lower midline (peduncle region) just above the water line.
